reasoning_content: The archive host works with apt. Now I just need to replace the broken repo URL in the source list with the archive URL. Let me rewrite the Dockerfile cleanly:

action.command:
cat > /workspace/deployment/postgres/Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM postgis/postgis:17-3.5

# Update package lists and install pgRouting for PostgreSQL 17.
# The upstream apt.postgresql.org repository no longer publishes the
# bullseye (EOL) suite, so it is replaced by the same suite mirrored on the
# PostgreSQL APT archive (apt-archive.postgresql.org), which is signed with
# the same key already present in the base image.
RUN sed -i 's|http://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/|http://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/|' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17-pgrouting && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
EOF
cd /workspace/deployment && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build db 2>&1 | tail -15
